reviewer.name: Independent Jinshu 031 scoped canon follow-up reviewer

proposals.before: I envy the three who followed Duke Mu—I would gladly sink with you.
proposals.after: I envy the Three Worthies—I would gladly sink myself.
proposals.reason: Chinese names only 三良 (the Three Worthies); Duke Mu is not named, and 甘心自沈 is the speaker willingly sinking herself. Remove the invented Duke Mu attribution and restore the speaker’s reflexive action.

decisions.reason: The current idiomatic replacement exactly follows 追慕三良，甘心自沈: it retains the Three Worthies as a collective allusion, removes the unsupported Duke Mu insertion, and correctly makes the voluntary sinking reflexive.
